key_insight: Turing Agent coordinates theorem and proof formalization to turn research-level mathematical arguments into machine-verified knowledge.
engineering_relevance: Its modular verification workflow offers a pattern for scaling trustworthy AI-generated proofs through decomposition, parallel checking, and reusable proof experience.
method: Separate theorem formalization and proof formalization agents.
Decompose proofs into auxiliary claims and verify them in parallel.
Reuse accumulated proof experience and selectively review semantic fidelity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports approximately 57–62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused RLMEval subset using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
watch_item: Machine-checked correctness still depends on faithfully translating the intended theorem; evaluation is concentrated in theoretical computer science.
paper_title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
